: Single-page app with two tabs (Leave Liability + Document Workspace). Auth gate via GenesisAuth/OIDC with branded loading screen. Server-side row scoping on Employee Leave Ledger via Owner ID field.

: Zustand store (useLedgerStore) with stale-request token pattern to prevent stale data from clobbering fresh fetches. Sync isAuditing/isImporting guards prevent double-fires. No persistence middleware needed — data lives in Taskade projects, fetched fresh each session.

: SDK v2 two-component split: createConversation + createAgentChat. useChat from @ai-sdk/react only receives a real Chat instance. Generic AgentChatBody parameterized by AgentChatConfig enables multiple agents without code duplication.

: All styling uses semantic CSS variables (--primary, --accent, --destructive, etc.), never fixed hues. Dark mode is the same scene relit, not a redesign. Chart colors use --chart-1 through --chart-5 for Recharts integration.
